prompt: A massive humanoid golem of moss-slicked gray stone and packed dark soil, tangled with roots, heaving itself upright out of the flat forest floor. Hunched forward, one boulder-fist planted on the ground, glowing green moss-light in the seams of its body. The background is a layered emerald forest canopy under a pale blue sky. Pixel art.
